captions: This is Tempsens Instruments IPO.
We will use the IPOAgents filing evidence to test the business,
financial quality, where the money goes,
competitors and risks.
This is education, not investment advice.
First, the business.
Thermal engineering.
Makes temperature sensors, calibration equipment,
electrical heating and specialised cable solutions.
Projects and OEMs.
About 69% of FY25 revenue came from projects/OEM work; the rest from MRO business.
Industrial end markets.
Serves metals, power,
chemicals and other process industries where temperature control matters.
The financial checkpoint is revenue ₹378.53 Cr,
profit after tax ₹62.56 Cr, and 16.36% PAT margin.
DRHP FY25: revenue ₹378.53 Cr,
PAT ₹62.56 Cr and borrowings ₹71.83 Cr.
Asterisks mean terms need final-RHP confirmation.
The offer is ~₹650 Cr*: ~₹95 Cr* is fresh money and ~₹555 Cr* is offer for sale.
Fresh money enters the company.
Offer-for-sale money goes to selling shareholders.
Where does fresh money go?
Debt repayment.
DRHP earmarks ₹55 Cr of the original ₹118 Cr fresh issue for borrowing repayment.
₹35.38 Cr capex.
Electrical-heating and specialised-cable capacity are named expansion uses.
Terms changed after DRHP.
Fresh/OFS values and price band in this chapter are provisional until a final RHP is published.
Now competitors and valuation.
The DRHP says there is no exact comparable listed peer; final valuation must wait for the final RHP and price band.
Balance the evidence.
Watch-out: Most of the quoted final issue is expected to be OFS.
Strength: Profitable DRHP business: 16.36% FY25 PAT margin.
Watch-out: Final offer terms are not in the available RHP.
Strength: Fresh proceeds are directed to debt reduction and capex.
Watch-out: Project/OEM mix carries industrial-cycle exposure.
Strength: Specialised thermal-engineering products.
For retail investors,
the stated minimum is ₹15,000* (50 shares × ₹300).
Retail bids are capped at two lakh rupees and allotment can be a lottery when an offer is oversubscribed.
Check the exchange pages and final RHP before making any decision.
